args.root_cause: In `parse_orders_csv`, the first line forces the entire input text through an ASCII encoder that silently drops every non-ASCII character (`errors="ignore"`) before the CSV is parsed. Any accented customer name loses its diacritics (or whole characters) before the row is ever read, so "José Martínez" becomes "Jos Martnez". The lossy line is unnecessary for parsing (csv.DictReader handles Unicode text fine), so it should be removed or replaced with a non-lossy approach. The unit test `test_preserves_unicode_customer_names` fails with exactly the reported symptom.
